Tumour of the uterine broad ligament, a reproductive structure; its ligament terminology does not establish locomotor tissue involvement.

Inherited erythroid marrow failure causing macrocytic anaemia and reticulocytopenia; no common additional organ damage documented.

Digestive-system tumour umbrella; hepatobiliary origin applies to a subset and does not establish hepatic involvement across most patients.

Familial focal epilepsy, with cortical dysplasia reported in 1/2 patients; both manifestations are neurologic.
Neuronal heterotopia and developmental delay in 7/7; toe syndactyly 5/7 and cleft palate 4/7 establish skeletal and oral involvement; other organs under 30%.
Autoinflammatory disease; arthritis 5/5, pleuritis 4/5; recurrent peritonitis is a major diagnostic criterion; renal amyloidosis is a separately coded complication.
Haemophilus directly infects and inflames the meninges; hearing loss is a minority complication.
Defined as inherited TTN-related myopathy; cardiac disease and respiratory failure characterize particular subtypes, without evidence they affect most across this umbrella.
